admission.justification: Module-boundary reset, an exact treatment register and private test-created machine resources protect different collision paths. The joint guarantee concerns surviving imported product owners and tmux isolation, not restoration of removed ambient or provider state.

guarantee: The Python suite isolates process state and test resources across module order and concurrent pytest processes. Module boundaries reset already-imported collection owners with registered callbacks and the explicit kernel worktree-service binding holder. The closed register assigns one treatment per scanner-visible state, with quiescent populations cleaned by their owning operations. Each process uses a private test-created tmux server and owns its cleanup. Removed ambient lifecycle owners and removed local Eve provider-process and socket guarantees stay outside the member obligation.
title: Test processes isolate mutable owners and machine resources
